topic: Mediabunny - How does multimodal AI work?

cues.text: Think of multimodal A.I. as one model taking different kinds of notes.
cues.caption: One model. Different kinds of notes.

cues.text: An image is a sketch: shapes, colours, and relationships.
cues.caption: Image -> visual notes

cues.text: Audio is a rhythm: sounds, tone, and timing.
cues.caption: Audio -> acoustic notes

cues.text: Text is a label: words, ideas, and context.
cues.caption: Text -> meaning notes

cues.text: Each sense becomes a representation: a shared kind of math.
cues.caption: Different senses -> shared representation

cues.text: The model combines those notes, then produces one answer.
cues.caption: Combine the notes -> one answer
